id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description:
The data settings for this component.

@uiSdlDesignerCustomRenderer(rendererType='')

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

children.description: The components to be rendered in the layout.

dragAndDropEnabled.description:
Whether the drag and drop context is enabled for this layout.
Similar to {@link UiSdlDragDropContext}.

attachedComponent.description: Component to attach to the top or bottom of the page

attachedComponents.description:
Allow bottom sheet to contain multiple components. Mutually exclusive with {@link attachedComponent}.
Use action {@link #setActiveComponentIdAction} to set the active component.

alignment.description: Render attached to the top or bottom of the page

collapsible.description: Whether the component should allow to be collapsed. If `false`, it will be either open (full-screen) or closed.

open.description: The open state of the component

expanded.description: The expanded state of the component

closeOnEscape.description:
By default, hitting escape will collapse the bottomsheet if it is expanded for the first time,
and close the bottomsheet for the second time. Setting this to true will close the bottomsheet
on first hit.

hideCloseButton.description: By default, the bottom sheet has cross close button on the top right. Set true to hide it.

activeComponentId.description:
When {@link attachedComponent} is an array of component refs, this determines which component to show in the
bottom sheet.

title:
Layout with a bottom sheet that either shows up at the top or the bottom the page
A bottom sheet is a container that hugs either the bottom or top of the page and
has the ability to open/close or collapse/expand.
name: BottomSheet
